name: Bold Poster
summary: The cover of a vintage Italian sports magazine: heavy tilted Shrikhand display that stamps down and swings to its angle, a classical Baskerville body, one tomato red, grids ruled in ink, and full-bleed red and dark panels. It feels printed.

palette.use: light: the off-white foot and stripes on alternating panels
dark: body, borders, headers, the dark statement panel
there's no grey: four colours only
the light tone again: four colours only
the lone accent: every numeral, rules, eyebrows, left bars, bullets, the progress bar, the full red statement panel; never body text, a tint, or a fill with no text on it
the dark panel; there's no second colour

type.case: sentence case Shrikhand; uppercase Space Grotesk labels
type.emphasis: tilt, red and scale; inline strong in body switches to Space Grotesk 600; no italic display

banned: a second accent colour; rounded corners
drop shadows, gradients, box shadows; the stacked text shadow anywhere but on a red panel
font substitutes; Shrikhand body, Baskerville labels, Space Grotesk headlines
default disc bullets; an untilted red statement
a crowded statement frame; edge-to-edge long lines
red as body text, as a tint, or as a fill with no text on it
italic display: Shrikhand is its own slant
fades on display type: it stamps; titles that keep moving after they land
